notes: Program quality synthesizes Doximity-style reputation, academic standing, and fellowship depth. City stats use Census populations and C2ER-style cost of living (100 = U.S. average). School and college scores are metro/state approximations. DO/MD/IMG splits and class sizes use 2026 FREIDA program surveys (three-year resident averages) where matched; a few programs use a current resident-roster count (marked roster); otherwise they are estimates from program type and typical mix.
